Requirements: R-7
Plan row: TS-7

Obligation: OB-7.

## Given

- The visual diff is open on a graph larger than the viewport at default zoom.

## When

1. Click zoom in, then zoom out, then fit-view.
2. Drag the canvas background.

## Then

1. P-zoom: the canvas transform scale increases after zoom in and decreases after zoom out (read from the viewport transform).
2. P-fit: after fit-view all nodes lie inside the visible viewport.
3. P-pan: after dragging the background by a known offset the viewport translation changes by that offset, while node positions relative to each other do not change.

## Evidence policy

`evidence_policy: ui`. Before and after image per interaction, actual steps, viewport transform values.

## Self-probe notes

- Each partition reads the viewport transform, independent of the click or drag action.
- Oracle AC7; no mock; the defect (control not wired) would leave the transform unchanged.
